name: Makeovers
overview: Scripture reveals that true makeovers are spiritual transformations initiated by God, who creates a clean heart and renews a right spirit within us, replacing mourning with beauty and praise (Psalms 51:10; Isaiah 61:3). This inward renewal contrasts with mere outward appearances, which can be deceptive and hollow (Matthew 23:27; Proverbs 31:30). Believers are called to reject worldly conformity and instead be transformed by the renewing of their minds, putting off the old self corrupted by sinful desires (Romans 12:2; Ephesians 4:22). Such divine makeovers glorify God by producing righteousness and genuine godly character.
